instruction.text: Fred went to the theatre last night. It took him 55 minutes to get there and he arrived at quarter past six. At what time did he leave?
The show started at 7 pm. It finished at 10:15 pm. How long did the show last?
Niamh is on her way to school this morning. She set off at 7:30. It takes Niamh 50 minutes to get to school. What time will she arrive?
The school day starts at 8:40 and is 8 hours long. It will then take Niamh 50 minutes to get home. At what time will Niamh get home?
Tim is going to football training. It takes him 20 minutes to get there. He leaves at 18:50. At what time will he arrive?
Tim’s football training starts at 19:15. It lasts for two hours and twenty minutes. At what time will Tim’s football training be finished?
Jane went for a run this morning. It took her one hour, 11 minutes and 23 seconds. She finished the run at exactly 08:20:50. At what time did she set off?

instruction.text: Jane had to leave to go to school at 9 o’clock. She finished her run at 08:20:50. How long did Jane have to get ready?
